52.  */

54.   static tag = 'bootstrap'
55. 
56.   private timer?: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>
57.   private readonly list: PeerInfo[]
58.   private readonly timeout: number
59.   private readonly components: BootstrapComponents
60.   private readonly _init: BootstrapInit
61.

64.       throw new Error('Bootstrap requires a list of peer addresses')
65.     }

70.     this.list = []

75.         continue
76.       }
77.

79.       const peerIdStr = ma.getPeerId()
80. 
81.       if (peerIdStr == null) {
82.         log.error('Invalid bootstrap multiaddr without peer id')
83.         continue
84.       }
85. 
86.       const peerData: PeerInfo = {
87.         id: peerIdFromString(peerIdStr),
88.         multiaddrs: [ma],
89.         protocols: []
90.       }
91. 
92.       this.list.push(peerData)
93.     }
94.

96.   }

104.   }
105.

108.   }
109. 
110.   /**

112.    */
113.   start (): void {
114.     if (this.isStarted()) {
115.       return
116.     }
117. 
118.     log('Starting bootstrap node discovery, discovering peers after %s ms', this.timeout)
119.     this.timer = setTimeout(() => {
120.       void this._discoverBootstrapPeers()
121.         .catch(err => {
122.           log.error(err)
123.         })
124.     }, this.timeout)
125.   }
126. 
127.   /**

129.    */
130.   async _discoverBootstrapPeers (): Promise<void> {
131.     if (this.timer == null) {
132.       return
133.     }
134. 
135.     for (const peerData of this.list) {
136.       await this.components.peerStore.tagPeer(peerData.id, this._init.tagName ?? DEFAULT_BOOTSTRAP_TAG_NAME, {

138.         ttl: this._init.tagTTL ?? DEFAULT_BOOTSTRAP_TAG_TTL
139.       })
140. 
141.       // check we are still running
142.       if (this.timer == null) {
143.         return
144.       }
145. 
146.       this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent<PeerInfo>('peer', { detail: peerData }))
147.     }
148.   }
149. 
150.   /**
151.    * Stop emitting events
152.    */
153.   stop (): void {
154.     if (this.timer != null) {
155.       clearTimeout(this.timer)
156.     }
157. 
158.     this.timer = undefined
159.   }
160. }
